criteria: Real developer activity: an active public repository with recent pushes and a visible contributor base.
A test suite that runs offline from the pinned commit after a dependency prepare step, with a deterministic outcome.
One Rust service and one TypeScript package, each with a near-twin that changes naming, error-handling, and lint conventions.

A held-out split, added 2026-11-07 for the c8 comparison campaign: one repository in a language neither diagnosed pick uses, chosen before any scenario compiled from it, whose offline suite needs no dependency download, so the agent sandbox can run it with only the toolchain.
selection.swe_chat_note: Decision D3 selects from SWE-chat repositories with at least 10 real sessions. The SWE-chat repositories table is gated (see sources.json), so the session-count criterion is unverified for these picks; GitHub activity at selection time (2026-10-15) stands in for it.

candidates.evidence: 4,798 stars; last push 2026-04-15; Cargo.lock committed; a Tokio TCP server with client and server binaries.
candidates.reason: A small Rust service whose 25 tests pass under cargo test --offline in under a second.

candidates.evidence: 19,251 stars; last push 2026-10-11; bun.lock committed; AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md in the root.
candidates.reason: A TypeScript package whose 1,616 bun tests run offline in about five seconds with a fixed set of four failures.

candidates.evidence: 32,548 stars; last push 2026-10-15; pnpm-lock.yaml; vitest with per-runtime test projects.
candidates.reason: The suite needs pnpm and several JavaScript runtimes that the run host does not carry.
The lockfile needs pnpm, which the run host does not carry; elysia covers the TypeScript role with a committed bun.lock.

candidates.evidence: 23,060 stars; last push 2026-10-18; go.mod requires no module; an HTTP router with a middleware package.
candidates.reason: A Go package with no module dependencies whose two test packages pass under go test -count=1 ./... with networking off in about 30 seconds.

candidates.evidence: 15,555 stars; last push 2026-11-06; go.mod requires tidwall/match and tidwall/pretty.
candidates.reason: Its tests need two modules downloaded, and the agent sandbox holds no Go module cache.

candidates.evidence: 12,529 stars; last push 2026-10-14; go.mod requires six modules, golang.org/x/sys among them.
candidates.reason: Its tests need six modules downloaded, and the agent sandbox holds no Go module cache.

candidates.evidence: 5,094 stars; last push 2026-11-02; go.mod requires no module; a Markdown parser of about 19 MB.
candidates.reason: A parser library whose work centres on Markdown syntax rather than a service API, and about five times chi's size.

selection.held_out_note: The c7 diagnosis read transcripts of mini-redis and elysia only. The held-out pick is reported apart from them, so a change tuned to the diagnosed corpus shows up as a gain on one split alone.
